def rotate_matrix(matrix):
    rows = len(matrix)
    cols = len(matrix[0])
    
    # Transpose the matrix
    transposed_matrix = [[matrix[j][i] for j in range(rows)] for i in range(cols)]
    
    # Rotate the transposed matrix
    rotated_matrix = [[transposed_matrix[i][j] for j in range(cols)] for i in range(rows)]
    
    # Swap rows and columns
    swapped_rows = []
    for i in range(rows):
        swapped_rows.append(transposed_matrix[i].reverse())
    for j in range(cols):
        swapped_rows.append(rotated_matrix[j][::-1])
    
    return swapped_rows

def is_anagram(a, b):
    # Remove spaces from both strings
    a = ''.join(a.split())
    b = ''.join(b.split())
    
    # Sort characters of both strings
    a.sort()
    b.sort()
    
    # Compare sorted strings
    return a == b

def is_anagram(a, b):
    # Convert both strings to lowercase
    a = a.lower()
    b = b.lower()
    
    # Remove spaces from both strings
    a = ''.join(c for c in a if c.isalnum())
    b = ''.join(c for c in b if c.isalnum())
    
    # Sort characters and compare their counts
    sorted_a = sorted(set(a))
    sorted_b = sorted(set(b))
    return len(sorted_a) == len(sorted_b) and sorted_a == sorted_b

import re

def parse_query_string(text):
    query_dict = {}
    pattern = r'\{([^{}]+)\}'
    matches = re.findall(pattern, text)
    
    for match in matches:
        parts = match.split('=')
        key = parts[0].strip()
        value = parts[1].strip()
        query_dict[key] = value
    return query_dict

def most_common_word(text):
    # Remove punctuation and convert to lowercase
    cleaned_text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s]', '', text.lower())
    # Split into words
    words = cleaned_text.split()
    # Count occurrences
    counts = {}
    for word in words:
        counts[word] = counts.get(word, 0) + 1
    # Sort by count, then alphabetically if ties
    sorted_counts = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
    # Get the most common word
    most_common = ''.join([word for word, count in sorted_counts])

def most_common_word(text):
    # Remove punctuation from text
    cleaned_text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s]', '', text)
    
    # Split into words
    words = cleaned_text.lower().split()
    
    # Count occurrences of each word
    word_counts = {}
    for word in words:
        word_counts[word] = word_counts.get(word, 0) + 1
    
    # Find the maximum occurrence count
    max_count = max(word_counts.values())
    
    # Filter words with the maximum count
    most_common_words = [word for word, count in word_counts.items() if count == max_count]
    
    # Sort words alphabetically and return the first one
    return sorted(most_common_words)[0]

import re

def most_common_word(text):
    # Remove punctuation and convert text to lowercase
    cleaned_text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s]', '', text.lower())
    # Split into words
    words = cleaned_text.split()
    # Count frequency of each word
    counts = {}
    for word in words:
        if word in counts:
            counts[word] += 1
        else:
            counts[word] = 1
    # Find the maximum count
    max_count = max(counts.values())
    # Filter to get the most common word(s)
    most_common_words = [word for word, count in counts.items() if count == max_count]
    # Return the first word from the most common words
    return most_common_words[0]
